description: This file implements the scheduler_event_logger class, which logs various scheduler events such as PRACH, RACH indications, UE creation/reconfiguration/removal, errors, SRS, CSI reports, BSR, HARQ ACK, CRC, MAC CEs, buffer states, PHR, and slice reconfiguration. It uses fmt and ocudu logging utilities to format and output logs based on the current logging mode.

classes.name: scheduler_event_logger
classes.description: A class responsible for logging various scheduler-related events and states, with different output formats depending on the log level.

methods.name: scheduler_event_logger
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the logger with cell index and PCI, and sets the logging mode based on logger configuration.

methods.name: log_impl
methods.description: Logs the processed slot events, either in debug or info mode.

methods.name: enqueue_impl
methods.description: Overloaded methods to enqueue various event types for logging, including PRACH, RACH indication, UE creation/reconfiguration/removal, UE config, deactivation, error, SRS, CSI, BSR, HARQ ACK, CRC, MAC CEs, buffer state, PHR, and slice reconfiguration.

methods.name: separator
methods.description: Returns a separator string (', ' or ' ') based on whether the buffer has content.
